notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.notes: With this new update we have added some new features to help you identify which bar you are looking at and if it can be moved or not, they now glow if you are aiming at them and are in range to be moved.

notes.title: Update 1.0.12
notes.notes:
-Added particle effect to teleporter  
-Added particle effect to electric teleporter 
 -Added particle effect when Cube hits reciever  
-Doubled Aircontrol  
-Retextured Cube, will add more variations  
-Fixed menu bug not allowing player to start at Level_41 
-Fixed menu bug when opening Level_41 it would open Level_21  
-Added bloom effect to cube and electric wire  
-Game now highlights the bar being looked at if it is in range .

We are also doing a full reskin of the game to improve the looks and will be releasing a new trailer soon.

notes.title: Duplexer Released!
notes.notes:
We did it! you can finally purchase a copy of Duplexer for yourself.
The developers will be streaming speedruns of Duplexer on [URL=twitch.tv/vantagegames]Twitch[/URL] throughout the entirety of launch day so check it out if you have any questions or need any help.
